items.fullText: 경제 금융 AI가 결제하고 은행 업무까지…글로벌 금융시장 대전환 발행일 : 2026-11-18 17:10 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 브렛 테일러 오픈AI 이사회 의장이 18일 싱가포르에서 열린 '싱가포르 핀테크 페스티벌(SFF) 2026'에서 발표하는 모습. 인공지능(AI)이 소비자를 대신해 구매와 결제까지 수행하는 'AI 에이전트' 시대가 열리고 있다. AI가 금융회사의 고객 응대와 업무 처리까지 맡기 시작하면서 글로벌 금융산업의 기술 변화가 빨라지고 있다. 스티븐 카핀 비자(Visa) 아시아태평양 지역 대표는 18일 싱가포르에서 열린 '싱가포르 핀테크 페스티벌(SFF) 2026'에서 AI 에이전트 결제와 스테이블코인을 차세대 상거래 시장을 바꿀 기술로 강조했다. 그는 “AI가 대신 결제하는 서비스가 시작되면 결제의 안전성뿐 아니라 이용자의 신원과 구매 의도, 위임한 권한까지 검증해야 한다”며 “스테이블코인 등 온체인 기반 디지털 가치도 전 세계 자금 이동 방식을 변화시키고 있다”고 말했다. 스티븐 카핀 비자(Visa) 아시아태평양 지역 대표는 18일 싱가포르에서 열린 '싱가포르 핀테크 페스티벌(SFF) 2026'에서 AI 에이전트 기술을 설명하는 모습 비자는 오는 2030년 전체 상거래의 25~30%를 AI 에이전트가 처리할 것으로 전망했다. 소비자가 AI에 구매 조건을 전달하면 AI가 상품 비교부터 주문, 결제까지 수행하는 방식이다. 전기요금 납부와 정기구독, 식료품 구매 등 반복적인 거래부터 확산할 것으로 예상했다. 이를 위해 비자는 소비자의 구매 의도를 검증하는 결제 기술을 개발하고 있다. 카드정보는 토큰으로 전환해 실제 카드번호를 노출하지 않고도 결제할 수 있도록 한다. 금융회사에서도 AI가 고객과 직접 소통하고 금융서비스를 제공하는 역할로 확대되고 있다. 브렛 테일러 오픈AI 이사회 의장은 금융회사가 개별 업무에 AI를 도입하는 방식에서 벗어나 고객이 은행을 이용하는 첫 단계부터 AI를 활용해야 한다고 강조했다. 테일러 의장은 “AI는 경쟁우위가 아니라 경쟁력을 유지하기 위한 필수 요소”라며 “앞으로 4~5년 안에 은행들은 경쟁력을 유지하기 위해 AI를 고객 접점과 내부 업무에 모두 도입해야 할 것”이라고 말했다. 실제 미국 주택담보대출 기업 로켓모기지는 AI 에이전트로 고객의 소득과 자산, 신용정보 등을 확인하는 대출 신청 초기 과정을 자동화했다. 이후 직원이 상담한다. 브렛 테일러 오픈AI 이사회 의장이 18일 싱가포르에서 열린 '싱가포르 핀테크 페스티벌(SFF) 2026'에서 발표하는 모습. AI가 금융업무를 처리하면서 발생하는 오류와 책임 문제도 해결해야 할 과제로 꼽혔다. 테일러 의장은 AI가 잘못된 답변을 내놓을 가능성을 완전히 없애기보다 오류를 탐지하고 수정하는 통제 체계를 구축해야 한다고 설명했다. 필요한 단계에서는 사람이 개입해야 한다는 것이다. AI 도입에 따른 금융회사의 비용 구조도 달라질 것으로 내다봤다. 기존에는 소프트웨어 사용료나 AI 처리량에 따라 비용을 지급했다면 앞으로는 실제 업무 성과에 따라 비용을 지급하는 방식이 확대될 수 있다는 설명이다. 테일러 의장은 “AI 에이전트가 업무를 성공적으로 완료하지 못했다면 토큰 사용량에 따라 비용을 지급해서는 안 된다”며 향후 4~5년 안에 소프트웨어 산업 상당 부분이 성과 기반 과금 모델로 전환할 것으로 전망했다. 싱가포르= 박두호 기자 walnut_park@etnews.com

items.fullText: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents At SC26, NVIDIA’s VP of Hyperscale and HPC laid out how researchers can combine simulation, AI and agents to accelerate scientific discovery. November 17, 2026 by Brian Caulfield 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems. In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science , the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance computing . He also detailed a new collaboration in quantum computing with IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory . “The frontier of computing and the new scientific stack is going to be simulation, as always, but combined with AI and the future of quantum,” said Buck, vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA. Buck opened the talk by looking back to his first public talk on CUDA, at an SC06 tutorial in Tampa, Florida, 20 years ago. NVIDIA now offers more than 1,000 CUDA-X libraries , he said. Open Models for Science Agents “[Agents] have been just a game changer in how we interface with our supercomputers, with our devices, our instruments and how we can do the research,” Buck said. Simulation remains the foundation of scientific computing, “which will always be on the top,” Buck said, with AI, quantum and now agents working alongside it. Nemotron for Science combines the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open model with a new open chemistry dataset and post-training recipes for life sciences and chemistry, Buck explained. Researchers can run it locally on a DGX Spark, a workstation or their own supercomputer. items.fullText: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance November 16, 2026 by Shruti Koparkar 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! In its MLPerf benchmarks debut, with results released today, the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform delivers leading performance across training, post-training and agentic inference. NVIDIA swept every MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark and, in its first MLPerf Endpoints submission, delivered more than 10x generational gains in throughput per watt for agentic AI — measuring how much agentic work a system delivers with each watt of power. These results are just the beginning. Vera Rubin performance will keep climbing through continuous optimization of NVIDIA’s CUDA-powered software stack , so the infrastructure that customers invest in today delivers more value over time. NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training v6.1 AI agents are now everywhere, writing code, running business workflows, answering customer questions and, as this week’s SC26 conference highlights , advancing scientific research. Faster training means smarter agents can reach users sooner, drug discovery models can keep pace with new lab data and fraud-detection models can adapt to new threats faster. MLPerf Training measures how fast a system can train a range of AI models to a target level of accuracy. The NVIDIA platform was the only one with results on every benchmark this round, spanning large language models, image generation, recommender systems and reinforcement learning post-training. In its debut, Vera Rubin NVL72 delivered up to 2x more performance per GPU than the highly optimized NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 system — early results that show the pace of generation-over-generation innovation. items.fullText: NVIDIA CUDA-X Libraries Give Agents the Tools to Accelerate Scientific Discovery November 16, 2026 by Kibibi Moseley 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! With expanded NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, including cuPhoton, cuPotential and cuSpa, researchers can sift through vast amounts of data to accelerate research, from astrophysics and materials science to single-cell biology. The speedups are helping scientists analyze larger datasets and model more complex systems. The new libraries give AI agents the tools to help researchers make discoveries faster than ever. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Bringing Black Holes Into Focus Seeing a black hole takes a telescope the size of Earth. The Event Horizon Telescope links radio dishes worldwide, generating petabytes of data that can take months to process. With NVIDIA cuPhoton.xBeam, a module within the cuPhoton Toolkit , black hole observations from the Event Horizon Telescope can now be correlated orders of magnitude faster than ever. Analysis that once took over a month now takes eight minutes. By combining global radio dishes into Earth-sized aperture, cuPhoton delivers unprecedented astronomical imaging resolution. cuPhoton successfully correlated observations of powerful black hole jets J1924 and 3C279 in the night sky — making it a reality to reconstruct a Messier 87* black hole galaxy in real time. The entire pipeline, from data loading and processing to visualization, runs on distributed multi-GPU systems or a compact NVIDIA DGX Spark system, helping scientists study how gas spirals inward under a black hole’s powerful gravitational pull. Steering Fusion Simulations Sustaining plasma at millions of degrees is essential to achieving stable, continuous fusion energy. But simulating its behavior is costly: on petascale systems, a single time step can take days, with simulations running for weeks. Over two days at COEX, more than 2,000 attendees converged for AI Day Seoul, bringing together Korea’s industry leaders, startups and developer communities advancing physical AI and AI agents. At the plenary sessions, Deepu Talla, vice president of robotics and edge AI at NVIDIA, said Korea is “punching above its weight,” with Doosan Robotics, Hyundai Motor Group, LG Electronics and SK Group — as well as startups like Real World and Luda Robotics — using NVIDIA platforms to bring general-purpose robotics into the real world. Jonathan Cohen, vice president of applied research at NVIDIA, showed how enterprises can build agents they own and control. Breakout sessions featured speakers from Coupang Intelligent Cloud, Doosan Robotics, LG AI Research, LG Electronics, NAVER Cloud, SK Telecom and Upstage. “It was a genuinely enjoyable time to have candid conversations,” said Hyunho Yang, research engineer for omnimodal foundation models at SK Telecom. “Seeing the passion of fellow AI developers was a real source of inspiration for me.” Community leaders share how they build with open models and tools at AI Day Seoul. The Agentic AI 10x Bootcamp Community Day brought together Pseudo Lab, Python Korea, PyTorchKR, HAERAE, Hugging Face KREW, Graph User Group, Womxn Who Code Korea, Dnol (Datayanolja) and other developer communities. Five finalists from the Hangul Day hackathon, co-hosted with Fastcampus, built agents trained on the Korean language and culture with the OpenShell runtime. The winning team, FlyGate, received an NVIDIA DGX Spark system. More than 500 developers also took part in full-day NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute workshops and NVIDIA Certification exams in Korean. items.fullText: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA Hyundai Motor Group and AIM Intelligence explore NVIDIA NemoClaw and OpenShell for secure enterprise agents, and LG AI Research opens API for ‘K-EXAONE-2.5’ trained on Nemotron datasets. November 8, 2026 by Nicola Sessions 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them. Hyundai Motor Group is exploring NVIDIA NemoClaw blueprints and the NVIDIA OpenShell runtime, while AIM Intelligence is integrating its Starfort platform with NVIDIA OpenShell to support secure AI agents for employee productivity and enterprise workflows . A key component of the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform, OpenShell provides a secure runtime with sandboxed execution and policy-based controls to safeguard sensitive data, manage access to enterprise tools and govern autonomous agent actions. AIM Intelligence , a Korean AI security company, is integrating its Starfort agent control platform with NVIDIA OpenShell. The goal is to combine OpenShell’s runtime access controls with Starfort’s detection of malicious instructions and data leakage. The company is also considering a preliminary proof of concept for the public energy sector, with potential applications across enterprise, industrial and robotics environments. On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea . Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts. NVIDIA Nemotron is a family of open models, datasets and techniques that help developers build specialized, efficient AI agents.
